verdict.rationale: Lium documents several ways to check capacity before renting: a keyless public JSON feed of every rentable GPU node, a public WebSocket that pushes which executors are rentable now (replacing polling), and an MCP server and llms.txt for live GPU prices and availability. GPU-type filtering is implied by spec-based renting (e.g. `--gpu H100`, rent-by-spec), but region-level breakdown is never mentioned. missing for 10: explicit evidence of availability broken down by region, documented per-GPU-type availability fields, independent or hands-on corroboration that the feed reflects real-time stock.
